title: Idolo qhipäxankir Alma
intro: Tiranía tuqit jachʼa mistuñ chʼamakanxa, uka jan amuytʼkay jaqix wasaran suytʼaskäna. Mä ajllit markan p’iqinchiripax mä qullan qulluruw divin comunión ukar makhatkäna ukhaxa, mä jach’a yant’aw qhipharkir jaqinakar purintäna. Aka jaqix mä taqpach ayllun iyawsäwinakap mayjt’ayañatakiw uka pacharux apnaqatayna. Kunapachatï pʼeqtʼirejj cheqpach kuttʼankäna ukhajja, mä jan uñtʼat wiñay mutuñaw utjäna. ¿Khitis uka chʼaxwañ munir ukat kʼari almaxa uk amuytʼasmati?
clues: Mä markamp chikaw viajiyäta, jupanakajj mä chʼamani tʼaqhesiyirin amparapat milagronak uñachtʼayasaw qhespiyatäpjjäna.
Kunapachatï pʼeqtʼiripajj irpañatak qollur makatkäna ukhajja, qhep qheparapkäna ukanaka taypinwa suyayäta.
Jupanakan kʼachachtʼäwinakapat wali valorani metalanak apthapisinjja, mä istʼasir mä aruruw tukuyta.
Uka luratanaka toqew mä generacionarojj wasaran diosapar jikjjatapjjäna sasaw amuyayäta.
Kunapachatï pʼiqtʼirix kuttʼankäna ukhaxa, sapa mayniruw uñtʼapxitäna, ukat kunas ukham sallqjañar puriyitu sasaw jisktʼapxitäna.
Aka pachan castigojax janiw khitis llamkt’kitaniti ni jak’achasiñapäkiti, mä p’inqa chimpuw wiñayatak aguantata.

Mä qollu patjjan lurat mä arca

options: Jan llamkt’añjam juchañchata, wiñayataki ‘janiw contacto’ sasina.
Tirano ukat ejercitopamp chika umamp chhaqhata

outcome.answer: Jan llamkt’añjam juchañchata, wiñayataki ‘janiw contacto’ sasina.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
